prompt: Demonstrate your working project and its tested revision. Independently interpret a supplied drawing, solve a trade calculation with units, perform a measurement/layout/inspection, and explain a changed requirement. Use the notebook and physical product; a teammate cannot supply your evidence.

science.description: Explains the relevant physical behavior and the limits of the classroom model using actual tests.

reasoning.description: Independently selects and performs a trade calculation with units and checks its reasonableness.

communication.description: Interprets the supplied plan correctly and creates a dimensioned drawing another person can follow.

transfer.description: Uses a checked measurement and inspection to implement, retest and explain a physical revision.
